correctness.rationale: Each τ-stable chessboard face comprises d diagonal singleton orbits and e off-diagonal paired orbits; oriented augmented chain sign is -(-1)^(d+e). Off-diagonal chosen pairs form a labeled simple graph H; both row and column occupancies are deg_H(i). Independent diagonal inclusion/exclusion gives (-1)^|E(H)|(1-1)^#{i:deg_H(i)<r}, so only r-regular H survive, each with nr/2 edges. Thus reduced Lefschetz=-(-1)^(nr/2)R(n,r), including nr odd case. Absolute trace yields Betti sum bound; r=2 two-regular cycle decomposition gives EGF; at r=n-1 Singh sphere theorem gives orientation sign (-1)^(C(n+1,2)+1). Independently enumerated invariant off-diagonal/diagonal orbits and labeled regular graphs for n2..4/all caps: traces 1;0,1;-3,-3,-1 (exact matches), without using saved log. Infinite validity comes from binomial cancellation, not finite enumeration.
